acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Fae family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Fae Monarch, T5, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Four-Season Sovereign (Sovereign) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two earth construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Fae Monarch with impossible geometry in limbs and wings, a crown cycling through four seasons at once, shattered-rainbow wings, and faint reality bending around the silhouette.

Signature mechanic: Arena Transformation — Simultaneous Seasons: one quarter of the season crown turns toward the viewer, impossible wing geometry folds that quadrant, and a lower Fae performs its learned rule inside the faint reality bend.
battlefieldDuty: Transform a four-season arena with impossible geometry while each crown quarter restages a learned lower-form deception.
constructionDimensions: Material/structure branches: T1 the palm-sized body, simple insect wings, and thorn grip gain one mineral balance bead; T2 layered petal wings gain sediment-set ribs; T3 stained glass and branch antlers gain crystal load keys; T4 gown, mask, and mote court gain rooted thorn clasps; T5 impossible geometry, season crown, and reality bend gain bounded fracture facets.

Motion/process branches: T1 the palm-sized thorn feint briefly loads its insect-wing balance bead; T2 layered petals transfer weight outer-to-inner; T3 stained glass and antlers commit one pane key; T4 the gown and mask court plant through a clasp; T5 the season crown loads and releases one stable reality facet.
counterplay: Answer the lower-form tell and break the exposed crown quarter; each broken season straightens one arena route and removes that transformation. Affinity signal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 the palm-sized thorn grip exposes its mineral-bead fault after the insect-wing feint; T2 a layered petal seam fractures after load transfer; T3 stained glass and antlers expose the pane key after commitment; T4 the gown and mask court expose a load clasp after release; T5 the season crown and impossible reality facet expose a fracture after the load releases.
forbiddenTreatments: Treating ordinary bark or branches as Earth affinity
identityInvariants: A slender weightless-looking silhouette retains layered wings while scale, head growth, and proportion change only at explicit tiers.
Spring green, petal pink, dusk violet, moth iridescence, and bounded gold pollen light remain source palette rather than affinity evidence.
Living leaf, petal, spider silk, stained glass, bark, dew, and moth wing remain discrete ordinary or uncanny materials.
Wing complexity and subtly wrong beauty escalate from a palm sprite to a sovereign whose geometry bends the surrounding frame.
telegraph: One seasonal crown quarter advances, a shattered-rainbow wing folds through an impossible angle, and the called lower form appears on the last stable line.
